end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping, slanting, and curved lines using letters such as H, T, A, and V. Om correctly identified line types in the direct examples and self-corrected the V example, explaining that its lines are slanting, not curved. There was still a mix-up when deciding whether bent-looking lines in A were curved, and the teach-back was not completed successfully. At home, play a short line hunt using letters and objects, asking Om to name each line and explain whether it is straight or curved.
